description: The repaired Node simulator is a reference oracle and fixture generator, never runtime code (Technical Plan sec.1.1, sec.9.2). Fixtures are only trustworthy if the oracle that produced them is pinned. Regenerating fixtures from a different oracle build requires updating this pin and saying why.
note: fixturesGeneratedAt stays null until M1 exports the first suite. A mismatch between oracleSha256 and the file on disk is a hard failure, not a warning.
